mapper.select: SELECT module, COUNT(*) as count FROM system_log GROUP BY module ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM system_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT sl.id, sl.admin_id AS adminId, a.name AS adminName, sl.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, sl.module, sl.action, sl.method, sl.url, sl.params, sl.result, sl.ip, sl.user_agent AS userAgent, sl.status, sl.error_msg AS errorMsg, sl.execution_time AS executionTime, sl.create_time AS createTime FROM system_log sl LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON sl.admin_id = a.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON sl.user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sl.id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT module FROM system_log WHERE module IS NOT NULL ORDER BY module
